framing.note: Detections are NOT deduplicated across frames. Frames sharing an event, and especially frames in one zoom burst, are re-views of the same birds — summing them inflates the count ~2.8x. PROTOCOL.md 9.

surfaces.note: PROTOCOL.md 5b. Every record here is census_class "undetermined" — the detector assigns no stratum, so nothing in this file counts toward the core count yet. Pass 2 sets stratum and surface; census class then follows from stratum.

caveat: A detection is a place to look, not an identification. Species, age, stratum, activity and tier are all unset; PROTOCOL.md section 4 pass 2 still has to happen on the crops.
